name: Ostrander Castings
description: Iron and aluminium foundry in the fictional town of Breckholt.

items.title: Casting tolerances sheet
items.content: Standard sand castings are supplied to tolerance class CT9, with a minimum wall of 4.2 mm and a maximum part weight of 380 kg. Sheet OC-TOL-11.

items.title: Apprenticeship programme
items.content: Ostrander takes 9 foundry apprentices a year; applications close on 2027-02-26 and the starting wage is $17.40 an hour. Brochure OC-APP-27.

items.title: Furnace start-up procedure
items.content: Furnace 2 is preheated for 3 hours 20 minutes before the first melt; the melt shop lead on call is Anders Pellow, extension 4471. Procedure OC-FUR-208.

items.title: Uniform and PPE allowance
items.content: Each worker gets $265 per year for boots and 3 sets of aluminised jackets; claims go through form OC-PPE-55 by 2026-12-15.

items.title: Customer quality claim from Halden Pumps
items.content: Halden Pumps found porosity in 1,260 pump housings from lot 26-0815 and is claiming $395,000. Our metallurgist traced it to wet sand on 2026-08-15. Claim OC-QC-5079-H.

items.title: Energy contract renewal
items.content: The gas supply contract with Brightmoor Energy was renewed at 4.85 cents per kWh for 30 months from 2026-10-01. Contract OC-EN-2210-G.
